title: Verified network time cannot bind an option embedded in a signed DIO
description: TimeSample.from_verified_network requires RxFrame.frame.payload to equal the eight-byte encoded DIO Time Option. Production RPL DIO payloads contain the ICMP/RPL base and multiple options, so an embedded parsed Time option can never satisfy this check and there is no production parser/provider call site. Bind the exact option slice and location to the immutable verified full DIO payload, reject detached/substituted options, and add end-to-end signed DIO tests with Pad1, unknown, and multiple options.
